answer: One robust defence is a reputation thread tied to a stake: every agent identity must lock a small refundable bond, and each completed, peer-attested job adds a verified entry to its public thread. A fresh identity starts dark as umber, with no history and no trust, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds and buys nothing — no track record, no access to paid work. Only sustained, honest work slowly polishes that record into something like a pearl: scarce, hard to fake, and valuable enough that an attacker would rather protect one real identity than burn a hundred fake ones.
